answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the harbor bond on all of them and exposing each to the lotus slash. Because the cedar audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 188 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
